text: dsh-skill-commands 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的技能斜杠命令匹配插件。它在浏览器注册一个以 / 触发的技能候选来源，从当前会话的技能列表中提供匹配结果。输入技能名称片段时，可按别名、名称后缀或有限的名称包含关系查找技能，例如输入 /studio 可找到 autonomous-studio；部分中文别名也会映射到预设技能名。选择候选项后，插件将对应的 /技能名 和空格填入输入框。适合希望用较短名称或中文别名快速定位技能的 DSH 用户。代码未声明额外 API Key 或外部服务配置。

dsh-skill-commands adds slash matching for skills in the DSH web client. Typing / suggests current-session skills by alias, suffix, or selected substring; /studio can find autonomous-studio. Picking a result inserts its full slash command. No API key or external service is declared.
想用 /studio 这样的短命令找到名字较长的 DSH 技能。
能不能用中文别名搜索并快速插入对应的技能命令？
I want slash suggestions to find a skill when I type only part of its name.
dsh-skill-commands 的功能「按别名和名称片段匹配技能」：在 DSH 输入框键入 / 和查询词后，插件从当前会话技能列表中按预设别名、名称后缀或符合条件的包含关系生成最多六个候选；选择一项会插入该技能的完整斜杠命令。

dsh-skill-commands README · dsh-skill-commands：Smarter slash-command matching for DSH skills.

The stock slash source matches skill names literally. This plugin registers a smart skill-matching slash source in the browser with suffix / contains / alias matching — for example `/studio` finds `autonomous-studio`.

The host half is an empty mount so the bundle loads cleanly; the behavior ships via `exports["./client"]`.

dsh-skill-commands README · Install：Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bundle stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.
